headline: High-risk data leakage and cascading-error pathways exist because Dexter has broad egress and file/API access while Notion AI can read shared workspace content and call vendor backends.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dexter can ingest external content via APIs and autonomous execution, while Notion AI reads workspace pages and databases. If Dexter writes prompt-like content into shared Notion pages, Notion may treat it as trusted workspace text. The pair lacks a documented provenance barrier, so the interaction is plausible in default use.
conditions: IF Dexter writes attacker-controlled text into a Notion page that Notion AI later summarizes or answers from
IF Notion AI is asked to act on workspace content without provenance labeling
mitigations: Add a visible provenance prefix to Dexter-generated notes before syncing to Notion
Restrict Notion AI to pages tagged as human-authored
Review any Dexter output pasted into Notion before asking AI to use it
requires-engineering: add content provenance metadata across the workspace

B_data_leakage.rationale: Dexter has broad network egress and handles financial data plus multiple API keys; Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to Notion backends and downstream model providers. If the same sensitive material is placed in the shared workspace or copied into Notion, it can leave the local boundary through both agents. The blast radius includes financial data exfiltration.
conditions: IF financial data from Dexter is pasted or synced into Notion workspace pages
IF Notion AI is invoked on pages containing secrets or regulated financial records
mitigations: Keep sensitive Dexter outputs out of Notion pages
Use a redacted workspace copy for Notion AI queries
Disable sharing of pages containing financial records to AI-assisted workflows
Rotate any API keys that were ever stored in shared notes
requires-engineering: enforce DLP/redaction before Notion ingestion

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Dexter can support multiple instances and uses autonomous execution, while Notion AI supports multiple instances with shared workspace state. However, Dexter has no documented filesystem write to the shared Notion workspace and Notion AI cannot write arbitrary host files or modify git state. The overlap is mostly read/authoring in Notion pages, so direct write conflict is limited.
conditions: IF both agents are editing the same Notion page concurrently
IF Dexter output is manually copied into a shared workspace page
mitigations: Assign one agent as the sole editor for a page at a time
Use page locks or naming conventions for draft ownership
Avoid concurrent edits during Dexter runs
requires-engineering: add optimistic locking for shared workspace artifacts

D_cascading_error.rationale: Dexter can generate research outputs from external APIs, and Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content. If Dexter-produced claims are stored in Notion, Notion may present them as authoritative without verification. That creates a default pathway for erroneous research to cascade into polished but unverified workspace knowledge.
conditions: IF Dexter-generated research notes are imported into Notion pages
IF Notion AI is used to summarize or answer from those pages without human review
mitigations: Mark Dexter outputs as draft/unverified before import
Require human review before publishing Notion AI summaries
Add a checklist item to verify citations in Dexter-derived pages
requires-engineering: add source-grounding checks before Notion answers

E_compliance.rationale: Dexter touches financial data and uses broad egress to multiple external APIs, while Notion AI is vendor-hosted and sends workspace content to Notion and downstream model providers. If regulated financial records or personal data are placed into Notion, residency and retention obligations may differ from Dexter's research workflow. The pair therefore creates a plausible compliance breach path.
conditions: IF regulated financial records are stored in Notion pages used by Notion AI
IF the workspace contains data subject to residency or retention constraints
mitigations: Keep regulated records out of Notion AI workflows
Confirm a DPA and retention settings for the workspace
Limit Notion AI use to non-sensitive pages
Document which data classes may enter each agent
requires-engineering: implement residency-aware routing and retention controls
